hints.title: Base Palindromic States
hints.text: Initialize states with length 1 paths at each single vertex and length 2 paths across edges with identical endpoints.

hints.title: Outward Simultaneous Step Expansion
hints.text: From palindromic path endpoints u and v, step outward simultaneously to neighbors with matching label characters.

hints.title: Breadth-First Search Order
hints.text: Expand paths in non-decreasing order of length to discover the maximum path distance across the network.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Breadth-first search over vertex pairs (u, v) tracking palindromic path extensions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive simple path backtracking explores factorial combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pairwise table of size V x V memoizes longest palindromic distances.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model palindromic path expansion from the center using BFS on vertex pairs.
